note: Built from the official trophy descriptions only. Hours are our own estimate.

stages.goal: Play Chapters 1-4 and the final mission, finish every named story mission and every contact's final mission, and pick up the early side content while the story is open.
stages.name: Story first
watch_outs: Meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony the first time the game offers it — one meditation spot is missable.
When the story's big decision arrives, think before you pick — a choice, once made, may not come again in this playthrough.
Try each activity type once while the story takes you around the map.

stages.goal: Mop up the open world: collectibles, exploration, races, fishing, the arcade, and the stranger side content the story left behind.
stages.name: Leonida cleanup
watch_outs: Work the WAiNK spots and the card sets region by region so none is missed.
Explore every corner of Leonida for the exploration trophy — it pairs with the vehicle and WAiNK cleanup.
Hunt Bret's unique animal and finish the stranger strands the story unlocked.

stages.goal: Clear the counters: 250 stunts, 42 gold Shooting Range challenges, 50 challenges, 5 bank vaults, the money goals, and 100% completion — then the platinum pops.
stages.name: Grind and platinum
watch_outs: Gold the Shooting Range challenges last — they are the hardest single grind.
Launder Marked Bills and spend in shops as you go; the money goals fall out of the heists and robberies.
Check the in-game stats page for what 100% completion still needs, then clear it item by item.

title: Road to the Platinum
